items.title: Sumner Labat Interview, 1962-11-11
items.q: You know Bunk used to play at the Great Southern Hotel.

ctx.x: That high society. Yeah. Oh yeah. That sounds like good bands they had over here. Yeah, yeah. Good band. Here, I'll close this. Oh. How you do? All right. Let's see. You all in any step? No, we just started. We went in. We're about in the middle of the way. We went in. You all in here, man? I'm fine. You all won't you just? You all won't you just? You all won't you? I came back. Hey, Governor. How's you, Jack? We got fun. I'm good, man. We got good memories, man. We're down as I am. Harry, say your name. You got…

Where did you play? We played Mobile all along the coast, played at the old Great Southern Hotel. Practically every week before we went down in Gulf Coast, sometimes twice a week. Then we played Mobile a gang of times, Eureka Gordon and several other places. I forgot the names of them. You know Bunk used to play at the Great Southern Hotel.

Yes. He used to come over here. How long ago that Great Southern Hotel was born here? I heard him, but I don't know him. He's a trumpet player. He used to come over here. How long ago that Great Southern Hotel was born here? I didn't have to go to a long time ago. Long time ago. Let me see now. What years were you with the Supreme? Is that the band you joined right after you came by? Right from school, that's right. And how long did that band stay up with you in it? For years and years. I don't know. I don't…
